findings.rationale: The jump security group allows inbound SSH from 0.0.0.0/0 on tcp/22, exposing an administrative shell directly to the internet.
The escalation role is broadly assumable and carries an attached policy that grants privileged actions, allowing a permitted identity to inherit excessive access.
The open jump security group chains to the escalation role through sts:AssumeRole, linking internet-reachable ingress directly to identity escalation.
The wildcard IAM policy grants broad access that can reach the S3 bucket, whose public-read ACL makes the object data externally accessible.
